Definition: a tree (from its firmness); hence, wood (plural sticks)
BiblicalUsage: 1) tree, wood, timber, stock, plank, stalk, stick, gallows; 1a) tree, trees; 1b) wood, pieces of wood, gallows, firewood, cedar-wood, woody flax
